    Good universal covers #

    The universal cover of P at x₀ is good when it has no oriented cycles and all its intervals are finite (CoverGood). A good cover gives HullFinite (hullFinite_of_coverGood). Without essential contours, paths with the same nonzero value are equal in the free groupoid, so the length is a positive cocycle and the cover is good (coverGood_of_noEss).
